about: TIMELY-FILING WATCH (William 10/6/2026: 'Send all these United ones and then write them off if they return timely filing'). Visits William ordered re-sent past the usual filing window. Every billing routine that sees an answer for one of these visits acts on it: timely filing (CARC 29 any group, or a filing-limit message) -> WOLATE write-off of the charge's whole open balance (move a patient-side balance back first with move_to_ins.move(cid), no seq); paid -> normal ERA posting; OA-18 duplicate -> standing duplicate rule; other denial -> standing denial rules. No approval card needed (William's order). Never re-send a watch visit. Chart ids / visit ids / charge ids and dollars only - no names or member ids.
